tenants.create.title: Provision tenant
tenants.create.description: Provision a tenant: write the tenant and register it (enabled) in the tenant directory; the administrator is created with tenants.initialize-admin. Platform side only. Without an edition the default edition applies (an error if there is none).
tenants.get.title: Get tenant details
tenants.get.description: Get a tenant with its administrator's user name and user count.
tenants.list.title: List tenants
tenants.list.description: List tenants with paging, filters, keyword and sorting.
tenants.update.title: Update tenant
tenants.update.description: Update a tenant's name, description, expiry and order; the name is mirrored to the directory.
tenants.suspend.title: Suspend tenants
tenants.suspend.description: Suspend tenants in batch: the directory marks them disabled, their users cannot sign in and calls carrying the tenant are rejected.
tenants.resume.title: Resume tenants
tenants.delete.title: Delete tenants
tenants.delete.description: Delete tenants in batch and remove them from the directory; tenants that still have users are rejected item by item.
tenants.initialize_admin.title: Initialize tenant administrator
tenants.initialize_admin.description: Create the first administrator of a tenant with every tenant-side permission; the password must be changed at first sign-in. Once per tenant.
tenancy.tenant.has_users: Tenant '{tenantId}' still has {count} users and cannot be deleted.
tenancy.tenant.platform_only: Tenants are managed from the platform side only.
tenancy.admin.name_taken: User name '{userName}' is already taken in this tenant.
tenancy.tenant.no_initializer: No tenant initializer is configured; the administrator would have no permissions.
tenants.mine.title: Tenants I can enter
tenants.mine.description: Tenants the current user can enter (home tenant and memberships, active only) and whether the platform is available; the control center switches with auth.switch-tenant.
tenant_members.list.title: List tenant members
tenant_members.list.description: List a tenant's members (users whose home tenant is elsewhere and who enter it by membership) with user name and display name. Platform side only.
tenant_members.create.title: Add tenant member
tenant_members.create.description: Add a user as a tenant member; rejected when the user is already a member or the tenant is the user's home. Platform side only.
tenant_members.delete.title: Remove tenant members
tenant_members.delete.description: Remove tenant members in batch; they can no longer switch into the tenant. Platform side only.
tenancy.member.exists: User '{userId}' is already a member of tenant '{tenantId}' (or it is their home tenant).
editions.list.title: List editions
editions.list.description: List every edition (by order, then code) with its whitelist size and the number of tenants on it. Platform side only.
editions.get.title: Get edition details
editions.get.description: Get an edition with its permission whitelist.
editions.create.title: Create edition
editions.create.description: Create an edition with an initial whitelist (tenant-side permissions only); it can become the default edition for new tenants.
editions.update.title: Update edition
editions.update.description: Update an edition's name, description, default flag and order; the code cannot change.
editions.set_permissions.title: Set edition permission whitelist
editions.set_permissions.description: Replace an edition's permission whitelist; the effective permissions of tenants on it narrow or widen immediately.
editions.delete.title: Delete editions
editions.delete.description: Delete editions and their whitelists in batch; editions still used by tenants are rejected item by item.
tenants.change_edition.title: Change tenant edition
tenants.change_edition.description: Move a tenant to another edition, or lift edition limits; its users' effective permissions follow the new whitelist immediately.
tenancy.edition.in_use: Edition '{code}' is still used by tenants and cannot be deleted.
tenancy.edition.permission_invalid: Permission '{code}' is not a tenant-side permission in the catalog and cannot be put into an edition.
tenancy.edition.no_default: There is no default edition; specify one when creating a tenant.
tenancy.edition.free_priced: A free edition cannot have a price.
tenancy.quota.storage: The tenant is out of storage ({used} MB used of {limit} MB); this needs {needed} MB. Clean up files or upgrade the edition.
tenancy.quota.seats: The tenant has reached its seat limit ({used} of {limit}); no more members can be added. Upgrade the edition or adjust the seats.
tenants.quotas.title: List tenant quotas
tenants.quotas.description: List every tenant's effective quotas and usage (seats, storage), optionally only those over quota. Platform side only.
subscription.get.title: Get my subscription
subscription.get.description: Get the tenant's own subscription: edition, expiry, effective seat and storage limits and usage. Tenant side only.
tenancy.subscription.tenant_only: Subscriptions belong to tenants; the platform has none.
openapi.tags.tenants.name: Tenants
openapi.tags.tenants.description: Provision, update, suspend, resume and delete tenants, plus administrator setup, edition changes, quotas and the tenants a user can enter.
openapi.tags.tenant_members.name: Tenant members
openapi.tags.tenant_members.description: List, add and remove tenant members (users whose home tenant is elsewhere).
openapi.tags.editions.name: Editions
openapi.tags.editions.description: Create, read, update and delete editions and their permission whitelists.
openapi.tags.subscription.name: My subscription
openapi.tags.subscription.description: The tenant's own subscription: edition, expiry, quotas and usage.
openapi.groups.tenancy.name: Tenants and editions
openapi.groups.tenancy.description: Tenant provisioning and lifecycle, tenant members, editions and subscriptions.

tenants.transfer_owner.title: Transfer tenant ownership
tenants.transfer_owner.description: Hand the tenant's ownership to a user whose home is this tenant or to an active regular member (enabled and not locked). The new owner gets the built-in administrator role; the previous owner keeps their roles. Platform side only.
tenancy.owner.missing: Tenant '{tenantId}' has no owner yet. Initialize its administrator first.
tenancy.owner.removal: User '{userId}' owns tenant '{tenantId}'. Transfer the ownership before removing them.
tenancy.owner.ineligible: User '{userId}' cannot own tenant '{tenantId}': they must belong to this tenant or be an active regular member, enabled and not locked.
tenancy.member.type_mismatch: User '{userId}' cannot join as '{memberType}': platform accounts join only as support, and support members must be platform accounts.
tenancy.member.window_invalid: The expiry time must be later than the effective time.
